summary.headline: Part of Fortune and Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Part of Fortune: its exaltation, term, house, angularity, and the condition of the Moon with Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, or Saturn, predicting fortune, character, occupations, relationships, and difficulties.
